title: Health and Fitness for First Responders

program.section_heading: Health and Fitness for First Responders Certificate of Completion (Noncredit)
outcomes: Select and apply strategies for health and wellness as they apply to preparation for Public Safety careers.
Students will be able to demonstrate the basic physical fitness requirements for law enforcement officers.
Students will be able to demonstrate the basic physical fitness requirements for law enforcement officers and display marked personal improvement on PAT tests.
Select and apply strategies for health and wellness promotion in preparation for Physical Ability Tests (PAT).
Students will be able to perform the basic physical fitness requirements for law enforcement officers and display marked personal improvement from previous PAT tests.

Select and apply strategies for health and wellness promotion in preparation and for the successful completion of the Physical Ability Tests (PAT) to meet Federal, State, County and Local hiring standards.

notes: Award is noncredit and counted in hours; all unit fields hold hours (108 hours per course, 324 total).
A later internal requirements table labels 'Required Courses (162 hours)' but lists three 108-hour courses and states 'Required Major Total 324 hours'; 324 recorded.

The 'Program Outcomes' section is cut off mid-sentence ('Physi'); the six Level 1-3 outcomes were copied in full from the identical text under 'Program Goals and Objectives'. Levels 1-3 appear to correspond to AJ911, AJ912 and AJ913 respectively but are printed as program outcomes.

A separate list under 'Successful participants will:' (personal fitness program, nutrition plan, stress, etc.) appears within Program Goals and Objectives; it was treated as objectives rather than program outcomes. Reviewer may wish to check.
Page includes internal eLumen workflow/checklist content (Program Goals form instructions, CTE checklist, workflow agreement) that is not part of the requirements.
